datasets.name: 2a99f965
queryLines:
-- kpis
select sum(o.revenue) as revenue, count(*) as orders, sum(o.revenue)/count(*) as avg_order_value, sum(o.units) as units
from workspace.aw_gold.fct_orders o
join workspace.aw_gold.dim_date d on d.date_key = o.order_date_key
where d.is_in_analysis_window

datasets.name: 185d2a84
queryLines:
-- monthly_by_channel
select d.month_start_date, o.channel, sum(o.revenue) as revenue, count(*) as orders
from workspace.aw_gold.fct_orders o
join workspace.aw_gold.dim_date d on d.date_key = o.order_date_key
where d.is_in_analysis_window
group by d.month_start_date, o.channel

datasets.name: fb14daae
queryLines:
-- category_monthly
select d.month_start_date, coalesce(p.category_name, 'Unassigned') as category_name, sum(l.revenue) as revenue, sum(l.order_qty) as units
from workspace.aw_gold.fct_sales_lines l
join workspace.aw_gold.dim_product p on p.product_id = l.product_id
join workspace.aw_gold.dim_date d on d.date_key = l.order_date_key
where d.is_in_analysis_window
group by d.month_start_date, coalesce(p.category_name, 'Unassigned')

datasets.name: d101f9f0
queryLines:
-- territory
select t.territory_group, t.territory_name, o.channel, sum(o.revenue) as revenue, count(*) as orders
from workspace.aw_gold.fct_orders o
join workspace.aw_gold.dim_territory t on t.territory_id = o.territory_id
join workspace.aw_gold.dim_date d on d.date_key = o.order_date_key
where d.is_in_analysis_window
group by t.territory_group, t.territory_name, o.channel

datasets.name: b6a02a34
queryLines:
-- margin_kpis
select sum(revenue) as revenue, sum(cost) as cost, sum(gross_margin) as gross_margin,
       sum(gross_margin) / sum(revenue) as margin_pct
from workspace.aw_gold.mart_margin_monthly

datasets.name: 69d8ec3c
queryLines:
-- margin_monthly_by_channel
select month_start_date, channel, sum(gross_margin) / nullif(sum(revenue), 0) as margin_pct, sum(gross_margin) as gross_margin
from workspace.aw_gold.mart_margin_monthly
group by month_start_date, channel

datasets.name: 988f893f
queryLines:
-- margin_by_category
select category_name, channel, sum(gross_margin) as gross_margin
from workspace.aw_gold.mart_margin_monthly
group by category_name, channel

datasets.name: 9ca5b158
queryLines:
-- customer_kpis
select count(*) as individuals, avg(n_orders) as avg_orders, avg(total_revenue) as avg_revenue,
       (select count(*) from workspace.aw_gold.mart_store_profile) as stores
from workspace.aw_gold.mart_customer_features

datasets.name: 8083e89f
queryLines:
-- customers_by_order_count
select case when n_orders >= 5 then '5+' else cast(n_orders as string) end as orders_bucket, count(*) as customers
from workspace.aw_gold.mart_customer_features
group by 1

datasets.name: ec6470b5
queryLines:
-- new_customers_monthly
select cast(date_trunc('MONTH', first_order_date) as date) as month_start_date, count(*) as new_customers
from workspace.aw_gold.mart_customer_features
group by 1

datasets.name: b764528a
queryLines:
-- top_stores
select store_name, total_revenue
from workspace.aw_gold.mart_store_profile
order by total_revenue desc
limit 15

datasets.name: e65ed0ee
queryLines:
-- supplier_kpis
select sum(purchase_value) as purchase_value, sum(received_qty) as received_qty, sum(rejected_qty) as rejected_qty,
       sum(rejected_qty) / sum(received_qty) as rejection_rate, count(distinct vendor_id) as vendors
from workspace.aw_gold.mart_vendor_quality

datasets.name: 6c5404de
queryLines:
-- rejection_monthly
select month_start_date, sum(rejected_qty) / nullif(sum(received_qty), 0) as rejection_rate
from workspace.aw_gold.mart_vendor_quality
group by month_start_date

datasets.name: e3e1d2d0
queryLines:
-- worst_vendors
select vendor_name, sum(rejected_qty) / nullif(sum(received_qty), 0) as rejection_rate
from workspace.aw_gold.mart_vendor_quality
group by vendor_name
having sum(rejected_qty) > 0 and sum(received_qty) >= 1000
order by rejection_rate desc
limit 10

datasets.name: 9a32bdd9
queryLines:
-- units_monthly_by_channel
select month_start_date, channel, units
from workspace.aw_gold.mart_channel_monthly
where month_start_date <= date'2014-05-01'

datasets.name: 569f89bc
queryLines:
-- units_monthly_by_category
select month_start_date, category_name, sum(units) as units
from workspace.aw_gold.mart_product_monthly
where month_start_date <= date'2014-05-01'
group by month_start_date, category_name

datasets.name: 14a432a1
queryLines:
-- top_products_units
select product_name, sum(units) as units
from workspace.aw_gold.mart_product_monthly
where month_start_date <= date'2014-05-01'
group by product_name
order by units desc
limit 10
